spec_match.rationale: Honestly-labelled simulation ('models the security info structure so you can prototype' — the API is IWA-only), with plausible per-endpoint SecurityInfo renderings incl. CT compliance; field naming should be cross-checked against the controlled-frame spec dictionary as it stabilises.

interactive.rationale: Four endpoint preset buttons re-render the full readout; CDP-verified: the expired.example preset showed notAfter 2025-12-31 flagged BAD/expired with TLS and CT rows populated.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises picking real-world/pathological endpoints and viewing how a controlled-frame integration would surface securityInfo; that is exactly the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Presets cover the good path plus self-signed, expired, and weak-TLS failure modes with per-field OK/BAD verdicts.

references.rationale: No chromestatus.com/feature/<id> link on the page, breaking the invariant-3 self-heal contract.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite leans on honest environment checks (secure context, controlledframe element creatable, SecurityInfo absent from Fetch Response — a nice negative assertion) and passes 5/5 here, but nothing exercises this page's simulated field logic.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Preset interaction driven via CDP with the readout verified and console clean on both viewports; as a labelled simulation there is no real-API path to observe outside an IWA.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected /public/demo-telemetry.js verified in the served DOM.

design_system.rationale: Warn-block, pills, and readout rows use the shared variables.

accessibility.rationale: Preset buttons are native, but the re-rendered readout has no live region and status pills convey state by colour+text without a grouped label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured at 360px: status pills reach 379px, a ~19px clip by body overflow-x:hidden; the rest of the layout holds.

openQuestions.title: Add the chromestatus feature link
openQuestions.detail: Invariant 3: link chromestatus.com/feature/5076692209106944 in the references so the self-heal script can recover this folder.

openQuestions.title: Let the pill row wrap on mobile
openQuestions.detail: At 360px the pills measure 379px and are clipped; flex-wrap the pill row.

openQuestions.title: Verify simulated field names against the spec dictionary
openQuestions.detail: The simulation is honestly labelled, but as the WICG controlled-frame SecurityInfo dictionary stabilises the field names/values rendered here (protocol, cipher suite, CT compliance, validation states) should be re-checked against the dictdef so prototypes built on this page transfer cleanly.

summary: Good honest simulation with real failure-mode presets (expired preset verified via CDP) and a clear IWA-only warning; missing the mandatory chromestatus link and has a minor pill clip at 360px. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshot + DOM dump) and raw CDP (real click dispatch, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so v145-only API paths were validated on their fallback branches, not the new-API success path. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental (blocked host) and was not counted against any page.
